shortDescription: NEW YORK, Sept. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- LifeMD, Inc. NASDAQ:LFMD, a leading provider of virtual primary care and pharmacy services, today announced that its Board of Directors has authorized a cash dividend to holders of the Company’s 8.875% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock NASDAQ…

children: , a leading provider of virtual primary care and pharmacy services, today announced that its Board of Directors has authorized a cash dividend to holders of the Company’s 8.875% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock
The preferred dividend will be paid on October 15, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business on October 2, 2026.

LifeMD® is a leading virtual care company making high-quality healthcare more accessible, convenient, and affordable. Through its vertically integrated platform, LifeMD connects patients with a 50-state affiliated medical group, laboratory services, a state-of-the-art in-house pharmacy, and a U.S.-based patient care center. Together, these capabilities support care across more than 200 conditions, including primary care, men’s and women’s health, weight management, and hormone therapy. For more information, please visit
